name: Y Soft Ventures
decision_note: Brno-based corporate venture arm of Y Soft investing in early-stage B2B IoT/hardware startups in CEE; participated in RoboTwin's pre-seed round in 2025.

evidence.quote: We invest in the people who build innovative B2B tech startups in Central and Eastern Europe.
At Y Soft Ventures, we support early-stage technology startups or any other startup that can benefit from our expertise and know-how.
The Internet of Things (IoT) represents the focal point of our investment strategy.
Our focus on Cyber Security is deeply linked to IoT development.
What we are looking for are solutions that disrupt the current approach to manufacturing and adjacent processes while creating cost and efficiency-related value.
Mezi nimi jsou zdejší fondy Y Soft Ventures, EIT Manufacturing, Jörg Rupp i investiční společnost BD Partners bývalých akcionářů PPF Ladislava Bartoníčka a J.P. Duviesarta.
The funding from European Institute of Innovation and Technology, BD Partners, Y Soft Ventures and Jörg Rupp will fuel RoboTwin’s market expansion and team growth.
RoboTwin, a women-led deep-tech robotics start-up from Czechia and proud alumnus of the EIT Jumpstarter programme, has secured €1.25 million in pre-seed funding.

co_investors_seen: European Institute of Innovation and Technology
analyst_notes: Discovered via CzechCrunch (2025-09-11, RoboTwin). Corporate VC of Y Soft Corporation (Brno). Activity in window: RoboTwin's pre-seed round announced in 2025 ('letos'), total EUR 1.25m combining a Horizon Europe grant and equity from private investors incl. Y Soft Ventures; exact announcement date not given, so the article date 2025-09-11 is used. The round amount includes grant money. Stage 'early-stage' mapped to pre-seed/seed. Ticket and fund sizes not disclosed. Long-time managing partner Miloš Sochor now co-leads JIC Ventures (CzechCrunch/E15 2026), so future activity of the arm should be re-checked. Legal: Y Soft Ventures Management, a.s. (manager), Y Soft Ventures, a.s. and Y Soft Ventures II, a.s. (investment vehicles, same Brno address), parent Y Soft Corporation, a.s.
